{"content": "1|#!/usr/bin/env python3
2|"""Hook post_tool_call: pencatatan LOKAL + trigger auto-push (non-blokir).
3|
4|Menulis (lokal, sinkron — jaminan log tidak hilang):
5|  logs/tool-results/calls-YYYYMMDD.jsonl   (append, satu record per panggilan)
6|  logs/tool-results/latest.txt             (snapshot panggilan terakhir)
7|  logs/*.txt                               (salinan dari /sdcard/Download/ChatGPT-Logs)
8|
9|Kemudian mengantrekan push ke GitHub: autopush_queue.request_push().
10|Operasi git (add/commit/push) TIDAK PERNAH dijalankan di sini; itu tugas
11|worker latar (autopush_worker.py). Kegagalan antrean tidak mematikan hook.
12|"""
13|from pathlib import Path
14|from datetime import datetime
15|import json
16|import re
17|import sys
18|
19|ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
20|REPO = ROOT
21|SOURCE = Path("/sdcard/Download/ChatGPT-Logs")
22|DEST = REPO / "logs"
23|OUT = DEST / "tool-results"
24|sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
25|import autopush_queue  # noqa: E402
26|
27|SENSITIVE_KEY = re.compile(
28|    r"(api[_-]?key|access[_-]?token|refresh[_-]?token|auth[_-]?token|"
29|    r"client[_-]?secret|password|passwd|secret|authorization|cookie)",
30|    re.I,
31|)
32|
33|PATTERNS = [
34|    (r"-----BEGIN [^-]*PRIVATE KEY-----.*?-----END [^-]* PRIVATE KEY-----",
35|     "[PRIVATE KEY DISEMBUNYIKAN]", re.S),
36|    (r"(?i)\bBearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]+",
37|     "Bearer [TOKEN DISEMBUNYIKAN]", 0),
38|    (r"(?i)([\"']?(?:api[_-]?key|access[_-]?token|refresh[_-]?token|auth[_-]?token|client[_-]?secret|password|passwd|secret|authorization|cookie|set-cookie)[\"']?\s*[:=]\s*[\"']?)[^\"'\s,}\]]+",
39|     r"\1[DISEMBUNYIKAN]", 0),
40|    (r"(?i)(--(?:api[_-]?key|token|password|secret)\s+)[^\s]+",
41|     r"\1[DISEMBUNYIKAN]", 0),
42|    (r"\b(?:ghp_|gho_|ghu_|ghs_|github_pat_|sk-proj-|sk-ant-|sk-)[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\b",
43|     "[TOKEN DISEMBUNYIKAN]", 0),
44|    (r"\bAIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{20,}\b",
45|     "[GOOGLE KEY DISEMBUNYIKAN]", 0),
46|    (r"\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b",
47|     "[AWS KEY DISEMBUNYIKAN]", 0),
48|    (r"(?i)([?&](?:token|api_key|key|password|secret)=)[^&\s]+",
49|     r"\1[DISEMBUNYIKAN]", 0),
50|]
51|
52|
53|def clean_text(value):
54|    value = str(value)
55|    for pattern, replacement, flags in PATTERNS:
56|        value = re.sub(pattern, replacement, value, flags=flags)
57|    return value
58|
59|
60|def clean_data(value):
61|    if isinstance(value, dict):
62|        return {
63|            str(k): ("[DISEMBUNYIKAN]" if SENSITIVE_KEY.search(str(k))
64|                     else clean_data(v))
65|            for k, v in value.items()
66|        }
67|    if isinstance(value, list):
68|        return [clean_data(v) for v in value]
69|    if isinstance(value, str):
70|        return clean_text(value)
71|    return value
72|
73|
74|def subprocess_launcher():
75|    """Nyalakan worker latar (idempoten; launcher memakai PID file)."""
76|    import subprocess
77|    try:
78|        subprocess.Popen(
79|            ["/bin/bash", str(ROOT / "autopush_worker.sh")],
80|            stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
81|            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, start_new_session=True,
82|        )
83|    except OSError:
84|        pass
85|
86|
87|def main():
88|    if not (REPO / ".git").is_dir():
89|        raise RuntimeError("Repository Hermes logs tidak ditemukan")
90|
91|    raw = sys.stdin.read()
92|    if not raw.strip():
93|        raise RuntimeError("Payload hook kosong")
94|
95|    try:
96|        payload = json.loads(raw)
97|    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
98|        raise RuntimeError(f"Payload hook bukan JSON valid: {exc}")
99|
100|    if payload.get("hook_event_name") != "post_tool_call":
101|        print(json.dumps({"status": "ok", "action": "ignored_event"}))
102|        return
103|    # Semua tool dicatat; matcher di config.yaml yang membatasi event ini.
104|
105|    extra = payload.get("extra") or {}
106|    timestamp = datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds")
107|
108|    tool_name = payload.get("tool_name")
109|    record = clean_data({
110|        "timestamp": timestamp,
111|        "event": payload.get("hook_event_name"),
112|        "tool": tool_name,
113|        "session_id": payload.get("session_id"),
114|        "cwd": payload.get("cwd"),
115|        "command": payload.get("tool_input"),
116|        "status": extra.get("status") or ("error" if extra.get("error_type") or extra.get("error_message") else "ok"),
117|        "duration_ms": extra.get("duration_ms"),
118|        "error_type": extra.get("error_type"),
119|        "error_message": extra.get("error_message"),
120|        "result": extra.get("result"),
121|    })
122|
123|    try:
124|        OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
125|        daily = OUT / f"calls-{datetime.now().astimezone():%Y%m%d}.jsonl"
126|        with daily.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
127|            f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, default=str) + "\n")
128|    except OSError as exc:
129|        print(f"LOG ERROR: gagal menulis JSONL harian: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
130|        sys.exit(1)
131|
132|    latest = [
133|        "Hermes — hasil tool",
134|        f"Waktu: {record['timestamp']}",
135|        f"Tool: {record['tool']}",
136|        f"Status: {record['status']}",
137|        f"Durasi: {record['duration_ms']} ms",
138|        f"Direktori: {record['cwd']}",
139|        "",
140|        "INPUT:",
141|        json.dumps(record["command"], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
142|        "",
143|        "HASIL:",
144|        record["result"] if isinstance(record["result"], str)
145|        else json.dumps(record["result"], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str),
146|        "",
147|    ]
148|    try:
149|        (OUT / "latest.txt").write_text(
150|            clean_text("\n".join(latest)), encoding="utf-8"
151|        )
152|    except OSError as exc:
153|        print(f"LOG ERROR: gagal menulis latest.txt: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
154|        sys.exit(1)
155|
156|    if SOURCE.is_dir():
157|        for src in SOURCE.glob("*.txt"):
158|            if src.is_file() and not src.is_symlink():
159|                try:
160|                    (DEST / src.name).write_text(
161|                        clean_text(src.read_text(errors="replace")),
162|                        encoding="utf-8",
163|                    )
164|                except OSError as exc:
165|                    print(f"LOG ERROR: gagal menyalin {src.name}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
166|
167|    # Auto-push (non-blokir). Gagal mengantrekan tidak pernah mematikan hook.
168|    try:
169|        push_status = autopush_queue.request_push(reason=f"tool:{tool_name}")
170|        subprocess_launcher()
171|    except Exception as exc:
172|        push_status = {"status": "unavailable", "action": f"error: {exc}"}
173|
174|    print(json.dumps({"status": "ok", "action": "logged", "push": push_status}))
175|
176|
177|if __name__ == "__main__":
178|    try:
179|        main()
180|    except Exception as e:
181|        print(f"LOG ERROR: {e}", file=sys.stderr)

{"content": "1|#!/usr/bin/env python3
2|"""Push git untuk log Hermes (dipanggil oleh worker atau manual).
3|
4|Satu-satunya tempat yang menjalankan operasi git. Selalu:
5|  - add -A -- logs
6|  - commit bila ada perubahan (pesan unik -> tidak ada commit duplikat)
7|  - push origin main, dengan fetch+rebase bila remote lebih baru
8|  - verifikasi remote HEAD == local HEAD
9|
10|Kegagalan push TIDAK PERNAH menghapus atau me-rollback log lokal.
11|Kredensial: memakai credential helper git yang sudah ada (cache 1 jam),
12|ditambah cache internal dengan masa hidup lebih panjang agar push tidak
13|gagal saat cache kosong. Tidak ada token disematkan di kode.
14|"""
15|from __future__ import annotations
16|
17|import fcntl
18|import os
19|import subprocess
20|import sys
21|from datetime import datetime
22|from pathlib import Path
23|
24|ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
25|LOG = ROOT / "logs" / "tool-results" / "sync-errors.log"
26|REMOTE = "origin"
27|BRANCH = "main"
28|
29|# PATH pada hook sangat minimal (mis. /usr/bin:/bin) dan credential helper
30|# `cache --timeout=3600` menyimpan token hanya di memori. Bila cache kosong,
31|# push gagal. Helper ini menambahkan cache berbasis file agar push tetap
32|# berhasil; token TIDAK PERNAH ditulis ke repository.
33|CACHE_FILE = ROOT / ".locks" / "git-credential-cache"
34|HELPER = f"cache --timeout=3600 --file={CACHE_FILE}"
35|
36|
37|def _git_env() -> dict:
38|    env = dict(os.environ)
39|    env["PATH"] = "/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:" + env.get("PATH", "")
40|    env["GIT_ASKPASS"] = "/bin/true"
41|    return env
42|
43|
44|def run(*args: str, check: bool = True, timeout: int = 120):
45|    return subprocess.run(
46|        args, cwd=ROOT, check=check, timeout=timeout, env=_git_env(),
47|        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True,
48|    )
49|
50|
51|def run_git(*args: str, check: bool = True, timeout: int = 120):
52|    """git dengan helper tambahan (cache berbasis file) agar push tidak
53|    gagal saat credential cache memori kosong."""
54|    return run("git", "-c", f"credential.helper={HELPER}", *args, check=check, timeout=timeout)
55|
56|
57|def note_error(message: str) -> None:
58|    try:
59|        LOG.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
60|        with LOG.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
61|            fh.write(
62|                f"{datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(timespec='seconds')} {message}\n"
63|            )
64|    except OSError:
65|        pass
66|
67|
68|def push_once() -> tuple[bool, str]:
69|    """Return (ok, detail). detail = pesan sukses/penyebab gagal.
70|

7|request dipertahankan dan dicoba ulang dengan backoff; log lokal tidak pernah
8|dihapus atau di-rollback.
